_meta.note: Design palette of archetypes, not the full bestiary. Concrete enemies (e.g. Cyclops00, IceMauler) pick an archetype's stat lean + tags. BIBLE GG-§14 cites these by id.

archetypes.name: Rusher
archetypes.behavior: Loads timeline fast; closes distance every turn. Wants to be adjacent and swing.

archetypes.name: Bruiser
archetypes.behavior: Slower load but high HP and threat. Best target for a pincer.

archetypes.name: Flanker
archetypes.behavior: Seeks pincer formation with another Flanker. Devastating if ignored.

archetypes.name: Ranged
archetypes.behavior: Wants distance; keeps gap from heroes; attacks across tiles (future: Line shape).

archetypes.name: Caster
archetypes.behavior: BUILT (US-026): when not adjacent, telegraphs an affinity charge-cast (EnemyPlanner.PlanCast -> EnemyChargeSequence) resolving at u=1; high reward for interrupting (US-027).

archetypes.name: Beast
archetypes.behavior: Cannot pincer (no Humanoid). Just rushes. Cheaper threat density.

archetypes.name: Mechanical
archetypes.behavior: Status immunities (Resistances 0 for Poison/Sleep). Pure HP race.

archetypes.name: Boss
archetypes.behavior: BUILT (US-083): authored HP-threshold phases via BossScriptLibrary -> BossPhaseRunner fires BossPhaseTransitionSequence on phase entry. Per-phase PrefersCharge knob. Cyclops enrages (Quicken) below 50% HP. Often a 2x2 (GG-§1.5).
